name: chess-random
description: Chess vs AI, with a Random mode. Web app packaged for Android and iOS with Capacitor.

scripts.build:web: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp index.html engine.js www/
scripts.test: node -e "const C=require('./engine.js');const n=new C.Game().perft(4);if(n!==197281)throw new Error('perft '+n);console.log('perft ok')"
